New lines start new columns. Sideways words preserve joining scripts, including Mongolian. Upright characters keep combining marks and emoji sequences together.

Choose a tab to show its controls. Main contains Navigate, Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use color confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add to palette is optional. Save as chooses a lossless file and location; Save writes there again. Export as makes a reduced or lossy copy without marking the drawing saved. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
